key_entities: omitting MCP server without an exact ready client
propositions: Codex MCP server initialization fails at startup when the PAT environment variable is absent or unset in the process environment, even if referenced correctly in config.
The documented credential setup prescribes a transient shell export that does not persist across shell sessions, leaving the PAT unavailable to Codex in subsequent invocations.

Local config files name environment variables (e.g. REBAR_CODEX_PAT) that do not match the canonical variable defined in repository documentation and tests (MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX), causing mismatch even when a credential is present.
The MCP client startup diagnostic omits the unresolvable server without reporting which environment variable name was expected or how to resolve it, making the failure silent and unhelpful to users.
